effects.scope: isolated temporary Git fixtures removed after tests

changes.result: LiveContext payload is private after context-ID computation.
Canonical roots, Git state, dirty content, inputs, configuration, tools, permissions, and effects are deterministically bound.
Only fixed protected /usr/bin/git or /bin/git is executed with a cleared environment and read-only Git configuration.
Public callers cannot self-issue write, external, or destructive grants.
macOS/Linux descriptor traversal uses openat with no-follow, directory, close-on-exec, and exclusive-create constraints plus recorded inode checks.
Build and revalidation preserve an exact path/type/size/content/mode/mtime snapshot of fixture worktree and .git state.
